title: Agent Live View
description: Follow AI coding agents as they work: changed files open in their own editor columns with the edited lines highlighted. Works with Claude Code.

title: Impulse Pair
description: Edite junto com alguém que usa o Impulse Code, em tempo real.

title: GoSaveTool: Subtitles, Images & Text
description: Convert SRT to VTT, shift and repair subtitles, compress images and convert them to WebP, count words and change text case. Works offline, nothing is uploaded.

title: RepoGates: what runs on open
description: Open a folder and see what would run on open. It reads the folder's settings; it does not stop the editor.
